TAKE-HOME CHALLENGE — The bridge between today and tomorrow (2 minutes)
READ each mission clearly so students can write it down or remember it:
MISSION 1 — AI Sighting Log: SAY: "Every day for the next 7 days, I want you to spot ONE thing that might use AI. It could be anywhere — on TV, in the market, at home. Write it in a notebook: What is it? Where did you see it? What does it do? 10 sightings by next week."
MISSION 2 — Human Algorithm: SAY: "Write instructions to make your favourite food — biryani, dal chawal, maggi, anything. But the instructions must be so precise that a robot with zero common sense could follow them. No saying 'add enough salt.' Exact amounts. Exact steps. Exact times."
MISSION 3 — Dream Machine: SAY: "Draw one AI gadget that doesn't exist yet — but should. Something that would solve a real problem in YOUR life. Name it. Write 3 sentences about what it does and how it learns to get better."
ANNOUNCE THE PRIZE: SAY: "The best Dream Machine design from this class will be printed and put on the school notice board. It will have your name on it. It will say: 'AI Innovation by [your name], Class 6/7.' And that is the beginning of an inventor's portfolio."
HIGH-FIVE TIP: Walk to the front of each row and high-five the first student. Ask them to pass it down. This physical ritual closes the loop on the energy investment of the day.
